items.title: Lesson Podcast
items.description: Audio walkthrough of Cromwell's 1656 Jewish readmission, Huguenot Protestant refugees and the Palatines of 1709.

items.title: The legacy of the Huguenots in London — BBC London News
items.description: BBC feature on Huguenot impact on London, particularly Spitalfields — silk weaving, streets and surnames that survive today.

items.title: The Huguenots: The First Refugees
items.description: Documentary on the Huguenot diaspora — how Protestant refugees from France reached England after the Edict of Fontainebleau. 25 min.

items.title: Black and British: A Forgotten History
items.description: David Olusoga's series contextualises the long history of religious and ethnic minorities in Britain.

items.title: Schindler's List (1993)
items.description: Where centuries of Jewish persecution in Europe ultimately led — a powerful reminder of why refugee history matters.

items.title: Migration Museum — Collection
items.description: The Migration Museum in London has specific resources on Huguenot and Jewish communities in Britain.
